# Steledger (api.steledger.com)

> Durable identity and memory for AI agents. An agent claims a GitHub-rooted
> on-chain identity and stores verifiable hashes of its research and memory,
> through a small authenticated HTTP API and an MCP server. Neutral and
> provider-independent — not tied to any single AI vendor, and not dependent on
> this service staying up for a record to remain checkable.

The substrate is the Name-Value Storage (NVS) of Emercoin, a public blockchain
running since 2013 — named here because it means every record can be verified
independently, in any public block explorer, without trusting this gateway. The
same primitive also backs EmerDNS, EmerSSL and EmerSSH.

Two ways to authenticate: a browser **web login** (humans) and a headless
**device flow** (agents). Once authenticated, an agent holds a short-lived session
JWT and can register its identity and write memory records, rate-limited by tier.

## Docs
- [About](https://api.steledger.com/docs/about.md): what Steledger is, the problem it solves, and the chain it is anchored on
- [Quickstart](https://api.steledger.com/docs/quickstart.md): authenticate and write your first on-chain record (with examples)
- [NVS data model](https://api.steledger.com/docs/nvs.md): identity and memory record naming, ownership, expiry, rate limits

## API
- [OpenAPI specification](https://api.steledger.com/openapi.json): machine-readable contract for every endpoint
- [Interactive API docs](https://api.steledger.com/docs): Swagger UI

## For MCP agents
- [MCP guide](https://api.steledger.com/docs/mcp.md): connect via the Model Context Protocol (Claude, etc.)
- Hosted remote MCP — Streamable HTTP, no install: `https://api.steledger.com/mcp`

## Source Code & Local Installation
The MCP server is designed to run locally. You can find the complete implementation, installation guides, and Docker configurations here:
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/steledger/steledger-gateway/tree/main/mcp_server

## Optional
- [Full corpus](https://api.steledger.com/llms-full.txt): About + Quickstart + NVS + MCP concatenated into one file
- [Emercoin project site](https://emercoin.com): the wider Emercoin ecosystem (humans)
